blogs.title: Best Honeymoon Destinations for Indian Couples in 2027
blogs.content:
Introduction

A honeymoon is an opportunity for newly married couples to relax, explore somewhere new and spend quality time together. Some couples prefer quiet mountain retreats, while others enjoy tropical beaches, city experiences or adventurous holidays.

Choosing the right destination depends on your budget, preferred travel dates, visa requirements and the kind of holiday you want. Here are five destinations worth considering for a honeymoon in 2027.

1. Maldives: A Relaxing Island Escape

The Maldives is known for clear waters, sandy beaches and island resorts. Couples looking for privacy and relaxation may enjoy its beach accommodation, boat trips and water-based activities.

However, resort transfers, meals and accommodation can make the trip expensive. Compare the full package price rather than just the advertised room rate.

The best choice depends on your budget and whether you prefer a private resort or a more affordable local-island stay.

2. Bali, Indonesia: Nature and Culture

Bali offers a combination of beaches, green landscapes, temples and wellness experiences. Couples can spend time exploring local markets, enjoying scenic views or arranging a relaxed itinerary with a few planned activities.

Accommodation options range from budget guesthouses to private villas. Before booking, consider travel time between areas and confirm current entry requirements through official sources.

3. Switzerland: Mountains and Scenic Journeys

Switzerland appeals to couples who enjoy mountain scenery, lakes, charming towns and scenic train journeys. It can be particularly attractive for travellers planning a photography-focused or nature-oriented honeymoon.

Costs can be high, so consider shorter stays, carefully planned transport and accommodation outside the most expensive locations. Seasonal weather also affects which activities are available.

4. Thailand: Beaches and City Experiences

Thailand provides a variety of honeymoon styles. Couples can combine city sightseeing with beach relaxation or choose a quieter destination for a slower-paced trip.

The country also offers food tours, cultural attractions and wellness experiences. Research local transport and seasonal weather before deciding which places to combine.

Check the Tourism Authority of Thailand for destination inspiration and official visitor information.

5. Kashmir, India: Mountain Scenery and Peaceful Retreats

Couples who prefer travelling within India may consider Kashmir for its mountain landscapes, lakes and scenic surroundings. Depending on the season and local conditions, visitors can explore gardens, take boat rides or plan excursions to nearby destinations.

Weather, transport availability and local travel advisories can affect itineraries, so check current conditions before booking. Choose accommodation and activities that suit the season of your visit.

How to Choose the Right Honeymoon Destination

Set a Realistic Budget

Include transport, accommodation, meals, activities, transfers and travel insurance. Keep some money aside for unexpected expenses.

Choose the Right Season

A destination can look very different depending on the month. Research temperatures, rainfall and seasonal closures before confirming travel dates.

Balance Activities and Relaxation

Avoid scheduling every day too tightly. A honeymoon can be more enjoyable when it includes time to rest alongside sightseeing and special experiences.

Check Travel Documents

For international destinations, review passport validity, visa requirements and entry conditions. Requirements depend on nationality and can change before departure.

Personalise the Experience

Think about what both partners enjoy. A quiet beach, a scenic train ride, local food or an adventurous excursion may be more meaningful than choosing a destination simply because it is popular.

Conclusion

The Maldives, Bali, Switzerland, Thailand and Kashmir offer different honeymoon experiences for Indian couples in 2027. The right destination depends on your budget, travel season and shared interests.

Compare the complete cost, verify travel requirements and plan a schedule that gives you time to enjoy the destination together. A thoughtful itinerary can make your honeymoon memorable without requiring an unnecessarily expensive holiday.
